item.title: Feeling overwhelmed by busyness? Try a time audit to reclaim your day
item.description: Psychotherapist Niro Feliciano suggests a time audit to identify time-wasters and prioritize what truly matters.

item.title: Are water facility hacks a new front in the Iran conflict?
item.description: Recent cyberattacks on U.S. water systems highlight vulnerabilities in critical infrastructure amid the ongoing war with Iran.

item.title: Gyms, salons and ice cream shops reshape America's Main Streets
item.description: Evolving consumer preferences are driving a significant transformation in the types of businesses that occupy storefronts.

item.title: Uranium mining revival raises tribal water safety concerns
item.description: Federal push to boost uranium mining in the West and cut reliance on Russian uranium worries tribal communities about drinking water contamination.
